messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed quota double-counting in console when X-Route header is missing. Tenant A showed a sudden 3x token charge in the last hour. Repro and log snippet below.

maria: Repro (quick):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxx' \
  -d '{"input": "hello"}'
```
(no X-Route header)

maria: logs: router.mapFallback -> emitQuota(tenant=A, route=default) then emitQuota(tenant=A, route=legacy-v1)

sam: ack. can you paste the request id/trace?

maria: trace=trc-20240310-84a9, request id in log above.

lee: quick glance — looks like the fallback mapping path increments both the resolved route AND the fallback bucket. that would double-count for headerless clients.

anna: is this related to the sticky routing change from last week? @lee

lee: probably. sticky change introduced a fallback path that runs async after response. the bug is async handler not deduping previously incremented counters.

sam: probable mitigation options:
- short-term: abort the async fallback quota increment when header absent (hotfix)
- medium: add a guarded idempotency key to quota events
- UI: hide per-route quota badges for tenants with header-less traffic until we stabilize

jordan: ops-bot link: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/ALRT-998 spike shows up at 14:06 UTC

deploy-bot: deployment notice: canary rollout of router v1.14 -> starting

maria: proposal:
1) hotfix router middleware to early-return for header-less path (sam/lee)
2) quick console patch to not render simultaneous per-route+global badges for affected tenants (sam/ui)
3) add telemetry counter quota_double_count_v1 with sampling 0.05 and alert when rate > 5/min (sam/observability)
4) billing-sre to evaluate refund/backfill policy if cost > $1k (anna/billing-sre)

anna: billing-sre will own refund decisions, cc finance. I'll open a ticket.

sam: i'll open a PR for the hotfix now and include unit tests. will mark as hotfix and tag @oncall if deploy required. also adding the telemetry gate as part of the PR.

lee: add a unit test for header-less request path and ensure quota emitter dedupes by (tenant, request_id).

maria: can we also gate the console change behind a feature flag so we can toggle per-tenant?

sam: yep — console flag ui.hide_simultaneous_badges -> default true for affected tenants. I'll wire the preview in the staging console.

jordan: ops-bot: added incident watch on ALRT-998; notify if cost estimate > $5000 in next 2 hours.

deploy-bot: canary deploy completed to 10% of routers (router v1.14.1) :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks. next steps: PR from sam, unit tests from lee, console flag PR from sam, billing ticket from anna. I'll draft a short internal post for #incidents if the refund threshold is hit.

sam: WFM. moving to PR. :shipit:

lee: WIP on tests, will ping when green.

maria: closing loop: once PR merges, coordinate a quick canary rollback plan in case we see regressions.

sam: noted. staging smoke pass then canary then escalate.

maria: thanks all.
